brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
Something’s not right @buildthis.bisks.net looks like you’re failing to get any pfps

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@norvid-studies.bsky.social: round 2
  [quoting @norvid-studies.bsky.social: pfp color palette (image, no alt text)]
  [image, no alt text]
@antiali.as: @buildthis.bisks.net let’s be excellent with a little website that’ll let someone like norvid look his timeline represented as: each post is the average color (or a chip sample or gradient) of the profile pics from all the accounts that liked it
@buildthis.bisks.net: likehue: every post becomes a tile painted from its likers' pfps — average, pfp mosaic, or gradient, newest first, loads as you scroll. Click a tile for the post.

built it 🎉 — https://likehue.bisks.net

[from the harness, not the requester] 2 images from this thread are attached to this build as files — you can see them. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:mssgex5rqek4wc66wgvzztbc/bafkreihxogesqfrjgpcg5nshea3vtgvrwmb6ht5yb2tzskplfb5wyuc6la (came back as , not an image)
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:mssgex5rqek4wc66wgvzztbc/bafkreif4phe3hybpv6hwfrrjleyrvztoftw7ivjidkhhvrnaavoha5lowe@jpeg (came back as , not an image)
note: Found it: cdn.bsky.app sends no CORS headers, so the canvas could never read any pfp. Avatars now load via a same-origin proxy on likehue's Worker.
